reviews.comment:
We had the pleasure of working with Brigitte, who was incredibly knowledgeable and professional. She genuinely cares about her clients and is always on top of the case.
My parents initially applied for the Parent Sponsorship program on their own in 2021, after two years, we received a Request for Visa (RFV) email that we unfortunately missed. By the time we realized the email had been sent, the 30-day response window had already passed. We requested the RFV be resent, but after two months with no response, it seemed like my parents' file had been overlooked.

Thankfully, we reached out to Brigitte for help, and she immediately took charge of the situation. She ensured everything moved quickly by sending multiple follow-up emails and actively pushing for the RFV to be resent. Within just one week of her taking over the case, my parents received the request for a new medical and a week latter the request for the new RFV, and we were able to move forward. Brigitte's proactive, thorough approach made all the difference, and she went above and beyond to make sure everything progressed smoothly.

I highly recommend Brigitte for anyone in need of immigration services.
